user.About: A Computer Science undergraduate at BITS Pilani and a Cloud Architect at Wipro, working onsite for HPE on private, air-gapped cloud solutions built with HPE GreenLake. I'm passionate about cloud infrastructure, AI/ML and frontend development — and outside of tech I enjoy exploring the universe, photography, and sketching.

RandomAboutText: Things I have Built (I am also maintaining them😑)

Things like 'Completed Projects' doesn't exsist in my life as I got an idea about a project and I start working on them. There's always something there which I find that can be improved. So every project is ongoing.

project1.name: Pokemon Team Analyzer

project1.tech_stack: HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, Tailwind CSS, API, PokeAPI

project3.name: LECTURE2NOTES
project3.description: It is a simple command-line python app that can record the notes or speaked lessons of teacher and convert them into Pdf Notes.

project4.name: LAN-Analysis
project4.description: A Python-based local web app with a React.js UI that analyzes a star topology LAN network, providing details on connected devices, bandwidth usage, network interfaces, Wi-Fi, vEthernet, and DNS server information.
